title: Capability ID namespace — v1 (frozen)
description: Reverse-DNS capability IDs, cross-referenced to the authority rung each implies (CAPABILITY_AUTHORITY_MODEL.md ladder). CMP-001..006 (multi-axis compatibility) and IMP-005 (authority may narrow, never widen) are unimplementable without this registry. A node's capability request MUST use an ID from this list, or the build fails LOOP-CAP-001. This is a v1 seed set — new capability IDs are additive (minor registry bump) and MUST NOT repurpose an existing ID's authorityRung.

capabilities.description: Observe workspace/project metadata (existence, names, non-content stats) without reading file content.
Read repository file content and history at a given revision.
Propose a ChangeSet for human review; produces no write until approved.
Write to an uncommitted draft/buffer (DocumentBuffer OPEN_DIRTY) — reversible, not yet committed.
Create a local commit. Reversible (git reset/revert) but a persisted side effect.
Push to a user-selected remote. External side effect visible to a third party (the remote host).
Rewrite committed history (rebase across pushed commits, force-push, filter-repo). Requires visible destructive-authority evidence.
Run a local process/build/test on the Android device itself.
Run a command on a user-configured SSH execution target (e.g. a Raspberry Pi).
Dispatch a workflow run on a user-configured CI provider (GitHub Actions, Gitea Actions).
Read from a connected serial/USB device (non-destructive).
Flash/erase firmware on a connected device. Requires exclusive device-operation lock + explicit destructive authority (DEVICE_STATE_AND_SAFETY_SPEC flash contract).
Make an outbound network call to a declared host. MUST be scoped to a manifest egress allowlist (LOOP-PKG-007) — a grant of this capability is never a general network grant.
Use a Keystore-held secret by purpose-bound handle for a single declared destination. Never returns the raw value to model context or logs.
Run inference on an on-device or ASOM-resident (127.0.0.1:11435) model. On-device default; no network egress implied.
Run inference against a cloud provider (Anthropic / OpenAI-compatible / Gemini). Always a 'watched object'; implies fb.network.egress + fb.secret.use to the provider host.
Request the Android system USB-permission prompt for a connected device. The prompt itself is the user's authority decision; this capability only initiates the request.
Read a package listing or index from a configured registry (static/Git-backed per MKT-009). Never implies activation.

Publish a deliberately-shared package/listing/result to the bounded marketplace. User-only rung; a loop node MUST NOT hold this capability (marketplace publish is never automatable, LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §23).
Publish an app/store release artifact. User-only rung.

engineVersion.definition: engineVersion identifies the LOOP CONTRACT/ENGINE surface — parser, canonicalizer, static validator, run state machine — as a SemVer string, decoupled from the Fonebrew app's own version number (which tracks UI/feature releases, not contract surface). Two devices on different app versions but the same engineVersion are loop-engine-compatible.
engineVersion.v1Meaning: First frozen contract release, corresponding to LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 plus this handoff pack's WP-1L-G0 registries (floop-container-format.v1, semantic-digest.v1, canonicalization.v1 fb-loop-canon-1, loop-validation-rules.v1, capability-ids.v1, model-capability-vocabulary.v1).
engineVersion.bumpRule: MAJOR: a change that makes a previously-valid definition.json invalid, or changes packageContentDigest/semanticDigest for byte-identical input (i.e. any change to floop-container-format, semantic-digest, or canonicalization registries). MINOR: additive, backward-compatible changes (new capability IDs, new validation rule codes, new run states that old engines can treat conservatively). PATCH: editorial/documentation-only.
engineVersion.declaredAsRange: A LoopDefinition declares minEngineVersion/maxEngineVersion (or an engineVersionRange) using standard SemVer range syntax (e.g. '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0'). Compatibility evaluation (CMP-001..006) resolves the installing phone's engineVersion against this range; out-of-range is a compatibility finding, not a silent block or silent accept.
